title: 北傍门 Bei Bang Men
subtitle: Gate in the garden walls

model.line: Assumed: a gate on the walls layer with no hall drawn at its point, so a small default box stands there. Confidence C.
rows: gate on the walls layer, no hall drawn at this point: a small default box
platform 0.77 m, eave 4.47 m, ridge 6.38 m above the ground
hip-and-gable 歇山, rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile
reduced towards the size drawn on the plan, to stand clear of its neighbours or the water

by the hall kit: 2 bays, steps on the back, front, 歇山 hip-and-gable with a rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile, bracket sets 斗拱 as a painted band. Drawn from the typology of its hall class, not from a picture of this hall (assumed, C).

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons. No text or drawing names it in 日下旧闻考 j80-82, the Qianlong poems on Kanripo, 養吉齋叢錄, Malone 1934, the witnesses of 1860, what search indexes show of the Yangshi Lei drawings.
